Name: Flower Color Picker
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Change the color of planted flowers.
Description:
**Flower Color Picker** lets you change the color of planted flowers.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
Left-click a flower while holding a flower of the same type that's the color you want. Don't stand too close, or you might harvest it instead.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/FlowerColorPicker/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
